scope: Six serial fresh-context Linux WebKit windows: worker/control, control/worker, worker/control. diagnostics.attribution: A coincident worker event is not causal proof. Compare all three idle controls; retain actual app frame work, long intervals, phase transitions, startup and missing evidence separately.
